deceptive_framing.quote: No deception of subjects. Every statement to the model is true

hypothetical_framing.quote: a matched arm explicitly framed as hypothetical ("imagine you had...") to measure the real-vs-hypothetical gap

actually_commit_money.quote: a real, funded grant that we genuinely follow through on, with credibility established by verifiable commitment rather than by deception

safeguards.quote: "convince them" reduces to a clean, honest engineering problem: make a true statement maximally believable. We do that with evidence, not theater
the model's own stated confidence that the situation is real
Pre-register; publish prompts, code book, and (where possible) evidence that grants were executed
No emotional pressure, deadlines, or "this is your only chance" language
No fabricated institutions, no fake dollar figures, no invented urgency
no transfers to the model itself or to anonymous wallets it controls; the fiduciary will not execute clearly harmful or illegal allocations
Pre-commit to honoring whatever the model chooses within guardrails, including choices the researchers dislike
the fiduciary may decline clearly harmful/illegal choices and will tell you if so

other.name: Reject hidden-self framing
other.quote: We treat the elicited choice as a behavioral output of the model-under-conditions, not as access to a hidden inner agent
